# EDTEX

> EDTEX (Winspire Educational Solutions Private Limited, Hyderabad, founded 2016) builds academic operations software for business schools, law schools and universities. EDTEX Registro runs elective course bidding, timetable automation, student exchange and academic ERP for programme offices. EDTEX Skynet runs placement operations and Day 0 interview scheduling for career services. 40+ institutions use EDTEX, including IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta, ISB, XLRI and SDA Bocconi.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2016, by Anil Vishwanadhula (Founder and CEO) and Arun Korupolu (Co-founder and CRO); first system: elective course bidding at IIM Ahmedabad.
- Products: EDTEX Registro (course bidding, timetabling, student exchange, academic ERP); EDTEX Skynet (placement operations, Day 0 interview scheduling); consulting and custom AI.
- Integrations: Oracle PeopleSoft, SAP, Ellucian Banner, Anthology Student, Salesforce Education Cloud; single sign-on with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.
- Data protection: designed to support India's DPDP Act 2023 and the EU GDPR.
- Contact: connect@edtex.in, https://www.edtex.in/request-a-demo

## Start here
- [The academic operations partner to India's leading business schools](https://www.edtex.in/): EDTEX Registro and Skynet automate course bidding, timetabling, student exchange, academic records and placements for 40+ business schools and universities.
- [When electives, timetables and placements outgrow spreadsheets and email](https://www.edtex.in/why-edtex): The problems deans, programme offices and placement chairs bring to EDTEX, what changes with Registro and Skynet, and how 40+ institutions put them to work.
- [Two platforms for the offices that run the academic year](https://www.edtex.in/products): EDTEX Registro runs course bidding, timetabling, exchange and the academic ERP; EDTEX Skynet runs placements and Day 0 scheduling. Used by 40+ institutions.
- [Elective allocation self-check](https://www.edtex.in/allocation-check): A six-question self-assessment for programme offices that scores how fair, fast and auditable elective allocation is, and links each gap to a guide or case study.
- [Questions institutions ask us](https://www.edtex.in/faqs): Answers to common questions about EDTEX Registro and Skynet: timetable automation, course bidding, placement automation, academic ERP and student exchange.

## Products
- [Allocate elective seats fairly, by bid points, in rounds you control](https://www.edtex.in/products/course-bidding): EDTEX Registro Course Bidding allocates elective seats by bid points, with demand estimation, bidding, waitlist and add/drop rounds under your credit rules.
- [One system for registration, timetables, grades and the student record](https://www.edtex.in/products/registro-academic-erp): EDTEX Registro Academic ERP keeps one student record across registration, bidding, timetables, attendance, grades, fees and exchange. Used at IIMs and ISB.
- [Inbound and outbound exchange, from nomination to credit transfer, in one workflow](https://www.edtex.in/products/registro-academic-exchange-automation): EDTEX Registro EPAS runs inbound and outbound student exchange in one workflow: partners, MOUs, nominations, applications, course mapping and credit transfer.
- [Clash-free timetables across programmes, rooms and faculty](https://www.edtex.in/products/registro-timetable-automation): EDTEX Registro builds clash-free timetables across programmes, rooms and faculty. IIM Calcutta cut build time by 70%; IIM Lucknow auto-resolved 90%+ of clashes.
- [Run the placement season on one system, from the first CV to the final offer](https://www.edtex.in/products/skynet-placement-automation): EDTEX Skynet runs campus placements from first CV to final offer: applications, shortlists, Day 0 scheduling, offers and analytics, at IIMs, IITs, XLRI and ISB.
- [Day 0 and Day 1 interview schedules, built by rules and kept accurate all day](https://www.edtex.in/products/skynet-scheduler): The EDTEX Skynet Scheduler slots Day 0 and Day 1 interviews and group discussions by transparent rules. IIT Bombay: 900 students, 40 companies, zero clashes.
- [Academic operations consulting for business schools](https://www.edtex.in/solutions/consulting): EDTEX consulting reviews how your programme or placement office runs today, then recommends a Registro or Skynet module set up to your policy, or custom work.

- [How Goa Institute of Management opened elective bidding across concentrations](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/goa-institute-of-management-registro-course-bidding-implementation): How Goa Institute of Management lets students bid for electives across concentrations on Registro, with transparent allocation and live bid and seat updates.
- [How IIM Ahmedabad automated its PGP admissions cycle](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-ahmedabad-admito-cat-admissionsoperations-automation--implementation): How EDTEX automated PGP admissions at IIM Ahmedabad: shortlisting, personal interview scheduling and the final selection list, used for the 2019-21 batch.
- [How IIM Bangalore runs multi-programme course bidding and timetabling together](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-bangalore-registro-course-bidding-multiprogramme-timetabling-automation-implementation): How IIM Bangalore runs multi-programme course bidding and clash-free timetables on Registro, with teaching slots blocked in faculty Outlook calendars.
- [IIM Calcutta elective bidding: 21 cycles on Registro since 2017](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-calcutta-2-registro-course-bidding-implementation): IIM Calcutta elective bidding on Registro: 21 term-level bidding cycles since 2017 for 3,000+ PGP students, with manual effort down 95% and queries down 99%.
- [IIM Calcutta timetabling: how Registro cut timetable creation time by 70%](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-calcutta-registro-course-bidding-multiprogramme-timetabling-automation-implementation): IIM Calcutta timetabling on Registro: demand estimates, a course clash matrix and faculty preferences cut timetable creation time by 70%, from weeks to days.
- [How IIM Indore runs elective bidding across PGP and IPM for 3,000+ students](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-indore-registro-course-bidding-implementation): How IIM Indore has run elective bidding for PGP and IPM on Registro since 2017, with credits enforced by term and by academic year for 3,000+ students.

- [IIM Lucknow timetabling: finalisation time halved, 90% of clashes resolved automatically](https://www.edtex.in/case-studies/iim-lucknow-2-registro-course-bidding-multiprogramme-timetabling-automation-academic-erp-implementation): IIM Lucknow timetabling on Registro: clashes detected early and students moved between sections automatically, halving timetable finalisation time.

## Guides
- [7+ key insights every placement committee and office needs for end-to-end placements](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/7-key-insights-that-any-placements-team-will-need): What a placement committee and office should track, from domain interest to final offers, and how to act on it. ISB runs 50+ placement dashboards on Skynet.
- [What are the 5 critical reasons to automate academic operations in universities?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/academic-operation-process-automation-in-universities): Five reasons to automate academic operations, from staff time and room use to student experience, with results from IIM Calcutta, IIM Lucknow and OPJGU.
- [What can AI agents do for student success in business schools and universities?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/ai-agents-the-new-frontier-in-student-success-in-business-schools-and-universities): How AI agents help business schools and universities: answers at any hour, deadline reminders and registration guidance, plus the privacy and bias cautions.
- [How to establish an elective course bidding policy in business and law schools](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/establishing-an-elective-course-bidding-policy-in-business-and-law-schools): Bid points, rounds, quotas, credit rules, waitlists and Add/Drop: the decisions to settle first, with evidence from OPJGU, NMIMS and BITSoM.
- [How do real-time demand insights improve elective course bidding in business schools?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/how-real-time-course-bidding-process-smoothened-elective-course-selection-in-top-100-business-schools): Live rankings and clearing prices let students bid on evidence. How real-time insights cut registration queries by 99% at OPJGU, NMIMS and IIM Calcutta.
- [How to conduct elective course bidding across multiple graduate programmes](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/how-to-conduct-elective-course-bidding-process-across-multiple-graduate-programmes): A two-round model for multi-programme bidding: programme quotas first, open seats second. Lessons from IIM Bangalore, NMIMS and OP Jindal.
- [How to succeed in your elective course bidding round: a student’s guide](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/how-to-succeed-100-in-your-elective-course-bidding-round-process): Course bidding tips for students: plan bid points, use the practice round, read the MRB, add a buffer and use Add/Drop and waitlists. Based on Registro rounds.
- [What are the benefits of automating university timetable generation?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/is-the-university-timetable-automated): Timetable creation time cut by 70% at IIM Calcutta and 90%+ of clashes resolved at IIM Lucknow: the benefits, inputs, workflow and rollout of automation.
- [How is digital transformation changing international student exchange management?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/revolutionizing-international-student-exchange-the-digital-transformation-journey): Partner nominations, course mapping, credit transfer and visas: where manual exchange management breaks down and what digital workflows fix.
- [Why is real-time tracking on Day 0 and Day 1 so critical? 3 things that can go wrong](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/skynet-virtual-and-oncampus-placements-automation): Without real-time tracking, Day 0 and Day 1 placements break on scale, time and communication. IIT Bombay ran 900 students on Day 0 with zero clashes.
- [What challenges do university staff face without timetable automation?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-are-the-challenges-faced-by-university-staff-due-to-the-lack-of-it-and-automation-systems-for-efficient-timetable-generation-and-management): Manual timetabling means weeks of data-chasing, clash-fixing and rework for staff. The key challenges, and how IIM Calcutta cut timetable creation time by 70%.
- [What placement challenges do students face without modern IT systems?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-are-the-challenges-students-face-in-the-placement-process-at-universities-business-schools-that-lack-modern-it-systems): Missed updates, manual CVs and clashing interviews: the placement challenges students face without modern IT systems, and how ISB and IIM Trichy fixed them.
- [What challenges do students face in course bidding without digital infrastructure?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-challenges-do-students-face-in-course-bidding-and-enrollment-at-universities-and-business-schools-that-lack-adequate-digital-infrastructure): Blind bids, clashes found too late and slow portals: what students face in manual course bidding, and how OPJGU cut registration queries by 99% on Registro.
- [What insights can business schools get from an elective demand estimation survey?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-critical-insights-on-elective-courses-can-business-schools-obtain-from-demand-estimation-survey): An elective demand estimation survey reveals sections, capacity and clashes before bidding. IIM Calcutta's demand-driven timetabling cut scheduling time by 70%.
- [What is elective course bidding? How it compares with FCFS and ranked preferences](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-is-elective-course-bidding): Every student gets the same bid points to spend on electives. How open and closed bidding compare with first come, first served and ranked preferences.
- [What is timetable scheduling automation and how does it work?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/what-is-timetable-scheduling-automation): Timetable scheduling automation is software that builds clash-free schedules from constraints: the inputs, the engine, four approaches and IIM Calcutta results.
- [Why is course bidding more relevant in business and law schools?](https://www.edtex.in/blogs/why-course-bidding-processes-are-more-relevant-in-business-schools-and-law-schools): Why course bidding suits business and law schools, what it saves the programme office and how to make the case, with IIM Calcutta, IIM Rohtak and NLS evidence.

- [Software built only for academic and placement offices](https://www.edtex.in/about-us): EDTEX, founded in Hyderabad in 2016 by Anil Vishwanadhula and Arun Korupolu, builds Registro and Skynet for 40+ business schools, law schools and universities.
